$comment: Derived from the real route table in src/App.jsx and the 195-URL sitemap in src/data/routes.json, with each template's section order read from its own component source. Section descriptions are grounded in the five CLONE_SPEC measurement documents at the project root. Hand-edit this file only; IA.md and matrix.csv are generated.

meta.source: https://www.evergreen.so/ — pixel-accurate React/Vite/Tailwind replica at this project root
meta.mirror: Measured from the live original; app source is the authority for section order
notes: Two <Route> patterns in src/App.jsx deliberately render a placeholder and are NOT templates here: '/employee-recognition/:slug' (verified in CLONE_SPEC_CONTENT_B §0 as not existing on the real site — the hub's only children are /for and /glossary, which are themselves collection indexes) and the '*' catch-all. Neither appears in the sitemap. Do not build pages for them.

template.detail-* are four distinct page shapes sharing one implementation (src/templates/TDetail.jsx); their block sequences genuinely differ, so they are four templates rather than one with a varying description.
Long-form prose on article, glossary, message, case-study and legal pages is deliberate placeholder sized to measured block heights. Titles, slugs, headings, labels and images are real.

categories.CHROME: Global furniture rendered once in the app shell and present on every route.
categories.STRUCTURE: Structural rhythm devices that separate content sections rather than carrying content.
categories.HERO: The page-opening block: eyebrow, headline, lede and any immediate call to action.
categories.NARRATIVE: Explanatory product or mission content — the blocks that make the page's argument.
categories.PROOF: Social proof: testimonials, customer logos, ratings and published outcomes.
categories.CONTENT: Long-form editorial body copy and the structured sub-blocks that appear inside it.
categories.COLLECTION: Listing grids and cross-sell groups that route the reader to other pages.
categories.CONVERSION: Forms, pricing, scheduling and closing calls to action.

chrome.announcement-banner.description: Full-bleed black bar above the navigation carrying a single promotional sentence and one inline link.
chrome.announcement-banner.scope: Per-route, not global: the homepage and every blog article, 54 routes in all. Absent on every other route, where the navigation sits flush to the top of the page.

chrome.navbar.description: Primary navigation: wordmark, six links, a demo call to action, and a hamburger that opens the mobile menu overlay. Static position, never sticky, no backdrop blur.

chrome.footer.description: Four-column footer: wordmark and social chips, three link columns, a newsletter capture field, and a legal row.

chrome.trial-modal.description: Full-screen overlay panel offering the two platform install paths, opened by any trial button and dismissible by Escape.
chrome.trial-modal.scope: Mounted on every route; opened on demand rather than rendered inline.

structure.leaf-divider.description: Decorative band of drifting leaf art over a flat colour bar closed by a 2px rule. The band colour follows the section immediately above it rather than being fixed.
structure.leaf-divider.scope: Every template except the blog index and the legal pages, which have no divider at all.

hero.homepage.description: The marketing hero: three-part headline with floating avatar pills, sub-paragraph, trial button, product screenshot on a scroll-driven track, platform install links and headline proof figures.

hero.page-heading.description: Shared centred page opener: headline plus a single supporting paragraph, with no call to action of its own.
hero.page-heading.scope: The four conversion and index pages that share it: case studies, contact, schedule a demo and referral.

hero.collection.description: Collection opener: eyebrow badge pill linking to the parent hub, headline and lede.
hero.collection.scope: All four collection index pages and all 102 collection detail pages.

hero.article.description: Article opener: eyebrow badge, article headline and a published-date line.

hero.comparison.description: Comparison opener: eyebrow badge, comparison headline, subtitle and an introductory paragraph.

hero.pricing.description: Pricing opener: headline, lede, the price card with its two framed avatars, and the trial call to action with its reassurance line.

hero.esg.description: ESG opener: headline and lede above the Environmental pillar's own content and photograph.

hero.our-purpose.description: Purpose opener: headline and lede flanked by a static leaf wreath that deliberately never animates.

hero.pillar.description: Pillar guide opener: headline and lede with no eyebrow badge, unlike every other collection page.

hero.blog-index.description: Blog index opener: a single large headline with no lede, badge or call to action.

hero.alternatives-index.description: Alternatives index opener: eyebrow badge, headline and an introductory paragraph.

hero.case-study.description: Case study opener: customer headline and subtitle beside a pull quote and the customer's portrait.

hero.partner.description: Partner opener: the partner's logo above the homepage headline treatment, with the partner offer sentence in place of the standard sub-paragraph.

hero.ebook.description: Lead-magnet opener: a bold-weight display headline and a multi-line lede ending in a small indented benefit list.

hero.legal.description: Legal document opener: document title and a centred last-updated line.

narrative.seeds.description: Two-column feature block pairing a product screenshot and its tagged-value badge with a headline and leaf-marked benefit list.

narrative.report-csr.description: Paired two-column blocks covering engagement reporting and CSR commitments, each a visual beside a headline and leaf-marked list.

narrative.esg-pillar.description: An ESG pillar block: tick badge, headline, body copy and the pillar's supporting visual. Repeats once per pillar with different content.
narrative.esg-pillar.scope: The ESG page, three times over for Environmental, Social and Governance.

narrative.sdg-goals.description: Four-up column row presenting UN Sustainable Development Goal categories, each an icon above a label and caption.
narrative.sdg-goals.scope: Shared byte-identically by the ESG and our-purpose pages.

narrative.goals-2027.description: Full-bleed leaf-green band carrying three serif stat columns against a 2027 commitment headline.

narrative.icon-feature-row.description: Three-up row of percentage-width columns, each an icon above a serif sub-heading and a short paragraph.

narrative.partner-feature.description: Partner-page feature block: centred display heading and copy above a two-column visual row. A rearrangement of the homepage's feature assets, not a reuse of them.
narrative.partner-feature.scope: Every partner landing page, twice per page.

proof.testimonials.description: Paired testimonial cards, each a framed customer portrait above a quote, attribution and company logo, with static decorative leaves behind.
proof.testimonials.scope: The homepage, pricing, referral and partner pages.

proof.logo-strip.description: Single row of six customer logos at individually measured widths. No greyscale, no opacity shift, no marquee.
proof.logo-strip.scope: The homepage, pricing, referral and partner pages.

proof.g2-rating.description: Review-platform logo above five stars and a rating sentence.
proof.g2-rating.scope: The homepage, pricing, contact, schedule-a-demo, referral, ebook and partner pages.

proof.stat-row.description: Row of four outlined stat pills carrying headline figures with footnote references.
proof.stat-row.scope: The homepage, the pillar guide and the partner pages.

proof.case-study-grid.description: Grid of customer story cards, each a logo, outcome blurb and link through to the full story.

proof.case-study-meta.description: Narrow outlined card listing six labelled facts about the customer — industry, size, location and similar.

proof.case-study-teasers.description: Row of teaser cards linking to the other customer stories, each carrying the customer's logo.

content.prose-body.description: The shared long-form prose container and its element type scale — headings, paragraphs, lists, blockquotes and figures.
content.prose-body.scope: Both legal pages, every case study, the pillar guide, every blog article and every comparison page.

content.prose-left.description: Left-aligned bare paragraph column used for short intros and asides, outside the rich-text container.
content.prose-left.scope: Glossary detail pages, and company-value pages that carry an absence note.

content.section-heading.description: Centred display heading that opens a block within a longer page.
content.section-heading.scope: Every collection index and detail page, plus the comparison and alternatives-index pages.

content.leaf-bullets.description: Leaf-marked bullet list of short statements.
content.leaf-bullets.scope: Collection detail pages and comparison pages.

content.leaf-definition-list.description: Leaf-marked definition list pairing a bold term with a short explanatory paragraph.
content.leaf-definition-list.scope: Company-value, team-guide and comparison pages, plus the pillar guide.

content.faq.description: Question-and-answer definition list. Always fully open — not an accordion, with no disclosure behaviour at all.
content.faq.scope: Every collection detail page, the comparison pages and the pillar guide.

content.message-grid.description: Grid of example recognition-message cards, each a message body, category badge and usage note, over static decorative leaves.
content.message-grid.scope: Message-set, company-value and team-guide detail pages.

content.sources.description: Numbered list of external citations, rendered inert because the clone carries no off-domain links.

collection.card-grid.description: Flex-wrap grid of white outlined link cards, each a serif title, optional description and a bold call-to-action label keyed to the link target.
collection.card-grid.scope: Every collection index and detail page, the alternatives index and the pillar guide.

collection.blog-rows.description: Single column of full-width split rows, each pairing a cover image against a copy panel. Row height is image-driven, so the pitch stays constant regardless of title length.

collection.related-articles.description: Pair of related-article cards carrying decorative leaves and an underlined call to action. Distinct from the standard link card.

collection.comparison-glance.description: At-a-glance definition list summarising a competitor's pricing, best-fit audience and website.

conversion.final-cta.description: Closing block: three reassurance columns above a display headline, trial button, no-credit-card line and the two platform install links.
conversion.final-cta.scope: Most templates. Absent from the blog index, the legal pages, the referral page and the pillar guide, which closes with a lead-magnet form instead.

conversion.contact-form.description: Name, email, company and message fields in a white outlined card, with a full idle/pending/done/error state machine and a honeypot.

conversion.referral-form.description: Six required referrer and referee fields plus an optional greeting, in a white outlined card with the shared form state machine.

conversion.lead-magnet-form.description: Name, email and company capture with a download action, used to gate a downloadable guide.
conversion.lead-magnet-form.scope: The ebook page, the pillar guide's closing block, and every blog article.

conversion.scheduler.description: Static stand-in for the original's third-party booking widget, matched to its measured box. Deliberately loads no external script.
conversion.scheduler.scope: The schedule-a-demo page and every partner landing page.

conversion.earnings-tiers.description: Row of outlined pills showing referral reward tiers, collapsing to a two-column grid on narrow viewports.

conversion.partner-cta-panel.description: Black full-width panel with a cream headline and button, promoting a partner product. The only block on the site using fixed pixel padding and non-standard corner radii.

templates.name: Referral
templates.note: The only full-chrome marketing template with no closing call-to-action block.

templates.name: Legal document
templates.note: Single section: no divider, no closing CTA and no decorative leaves anywhere.

templates.name: Blog index
templates.note: No divider and no closing CTA — the only index template with neither.

templates.name: Collection index
templates.note: One component tree serving all four collection indexes; only the headline, lede, card array and cross-sell group differ.

templates.name: Pillar guide
templates.note: The only template that replaces the shared closing CTA with a lead-magnet form.
